Katib al-Wilaya Mosque

📍 Gaza City, gaza-city
Historic Mosque gaza-city 1432 destroyed

Historic Mamluk-era mosque (15th century) located beside Church of Saint Porphyrius symbolizing peaceful coexistence. Damaged in October strike on church compound. Completely destroyed in December 2023 airstrikes. Represented Gaza's interfaith heritage and architectural history.
